title: Payment methods & regional billing
content:
## Overview

Emergent routes your credit purchase through the payment processor best suited to your country and currency. We support **Stripe**, **Razorpay**, **PagBrasil**, **Paddle**, and **RevenueCat** depending on where you are and how you pay.

Credit prices vary by currency to reflect local purchasing power and payment-processing costs. We do **not** store card details on our servers—all tokenization and secure storage happens at the processor.

---

## Supported payment processors

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Stripe" icon="credit-card" href="/stripe">
    Global coverage, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers in 40+ countries.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Razorpay" icon="building-columns" href="/razorpay">
    India-specific: UPI, Netbanking, cards, wallets. INR-optimized.
  </Card>
  <Card title="PagBrasil" icon="landmark">
    Brazil: Pix, boleto, local cards. BRL transactions.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Paddle" icon="globe">
    Merchant-of-record model; handles VAT/sales tax automatically.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

When you click **Buy Credits**, Emergent chooses the processor based on:

- **Your IP geolocation** and browser locale.
- **Your selected currency** (USD, INR, BRL, KRW, EUR, GBP).
- **Regulatory fit**—some processors are better licensed for certain regions.

<Note>
You cannot manually pick a processor. The platform selects the optimal route to minimize fees and maximize payment-method availability.
</Note>

---

## Currency-specific credit rates

Credit prices differ by currency. The table below shows the **indicative rate** for **1,000 credits**; actual bundles may offer volume discounts.

| Currency | ~1,000 credits | Notes |
|----------|----------------|-------|
| **USD** | ~$10 | Default global rate |
| **INR** | ~₹750 | Razorpay, lower per-credit cost |
| **BRL** | ~R$50 | PagBrasil, accounts for Pix fees |
| **KRW** | ~₩12,000 | Stripe Korea, card/bank transfer |
| **EUR** | ~€9 | Stripe/Paddle, VAT added at checkout |
| **GBP** | ~£8 | Stripe UK, VAT included |

<Warning>
Rates are illustrative. The workspace **Buy Credits** page shows the live, region-locked price including any taxes or payment-gateway surcharges.
</Warning>

See [How credits work](/how-credits-work) and [Credit expiry & recharging](/credit-expiry-recharging) for usage mechanics.

---

## How payment routing works

<Steps>
  <Step title="You click Buy Credits">
    The platform reads your IP, browser `Accept-Language`, and any previously used currency preference.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Currency & processor are selected">
    Emergent picks the processor with the lowest combined fee + best local method support for your region.
  </Step>
  <Step title="You complete payment">
    You are redirected to the processor's hosted checkout (Stripe, Razorpay, etc.). Card details never touch our servers.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Credits land in your workspace">
    On successful webhook confirmation, credits appear within seconds. If the webhook is delayed, credits may take up to 5 minutes.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Tip>
If you travel or use a VPN, the platform may offer a different processor/currency. You can manually switch currency in the checkout selector if multiple options are available.
</Tip>

---

## Legal entity names on your statement

Depending on the processor, your bank or credit-card statement will show one of these:

| Processor | Statement descriptor |
|-----------|----------------------|
| **Stripe** | `EMERGENT AI` or `EMERGENT.AI` |
| **Razorpay** | `EMERGENT INDIA` or `RAZORPAY*EMERGENT` |
| **PagBrasil** | `PAGBRASIL*EMERGENT` |
| **Paddle** | `PADDLE.NET*EMERGENT` |
| **RevenueCat** | `REVENUECAT*EMERGENT` (mobile IAP receipts) |

<Note>
Paddle acts as **merchant of record**, so the legal invoice entity is Paddle.com Market Ltd. (UK) or Paddle.com Inc. (US). VAT/sales tax is calculated and remitted by Paddle.
</Note>

---

## No stored cards

Emergent **does not store** your card number, CVV, or full PAN. When you pay:

1. The processor (Stripe, Razorpay, etc.) tokenizes your card and returns a non-sensitive token.
2. We store only the token, last four digits, brand (Visa/Mastercard), and expiry—for display purposes.
3. Subsequent purchases use the same token; you can delete saved methods in **Settings → Billing**.

<Info>
If you delete a saved payment method, you will be prompted to re-enter card details on your next purchase. No billing happens without your explicit "Buy" click.
</Info>

---

## Cryptocurrency & stablecoins

We accept **USDC** (on Ethereum, Polygon, and Solana) and **USDT** (Ethereum, Tron) through a **Coinbase Commerce** integration. When you select crypto:

- You are given a time-limited wallet address and exact amount.
- Credits are added **after 1 on-chain confirmation** (typically < 5 min for Polygon/Solana, ~15 min for Ethereum).
- The exchange rate is locked for **15 minutes**; if you send after expiry, contact support for manual reconciliation.

<Warning title="Testnet tokens are not accepted">
Only send mainnet stablecoins. Sending test USDC or tokens on the wrong chain will result in **permanent loss**—we cannot recover cross-chain sends.
</Warning>

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Why does the crypto price differ from card price?">
    Crypto checkout includes a **~2% processor fee** and a **volatility buffer** for stablecoin de-pegging risk. The final credit count is guaranteed once you send.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="Can I pay in Bitcoin or Ethereum?">
    Not currently. We accept only **USDC** and **USDT** to avoid slippage and ensure instant fiat conversion.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="Do I get an invoice for crypto payments?">
    Yes. An invoice PDF is emailed within 24 hours. For tax purposes, the invoice shows the USD-equivalent value at the time of payment.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

---

## Refunds & chargebacks

Emergent credits are **non-refundable** once delivered, except:

- **Duplicate charge** due to a processor error.
- **Unauthorized transaction** (you must file a support ticket within 48 hours).
- **Service outage** preventing credit usage for > 72 hours (pro-rata credit restoration).

<Danger title="Chargebacks freeze your workspace">
Initiating a chargeback before contacting support will **immediately suspend** your workspace and all running apps until the dispute is resolved. Chargeback fees may be passed through.
</Danger>

If you believe you were overcharged, email **billing@emergent.ai** with your transaction ID before disputing with your bank.

---

## VAT, GST & sales tax

- **India (GST)**: 18% GST is added at checkout for Razorpay transactions if you do not provide a valid GSTIN.
- **EU (VAT)**: Stripe and Paddle add VAT (15–27%) based on your IP; business customers can reverse-charge by entering a valid VAT ID.
- **US sales tax**: Applied in states where Emergent has nexus (currently CA, NY, TX, WA). Paddle handles remittance.
- **Brazil (ISS/PIS/COFINS)**: Included in the BRL rate; no separate line item.

<Info>
If you need a VAT invoice with your company details, add your VAT ID in **Settings → Billing → Tax Information** before purchase. Invoices are regenerated automatically.
</Info>

---

## Changing your default currency

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Payment Methods**.
2. Click **Change Currency**.
3. Select your preferred currency from the dropdown.
4. The next credit purchase will use that currency and route to the corresponding processor.

<Note>
Changing currency does **not** convert existing credit balances. Credits purchased in INR remain denominated in INR; future purchases in USD will appear as a separate balance.
</Note>

---

## Multi-currency credit balances

If you purchase credits in **multiple currencies** (e.g., USD and INR), your workspace will show separate balances:

- **1,250 credits (USD)** – used first for new app runs.
- **800 credits (INR)** – used after USD balance is exhausted.

The platform **spends the oldest credits first** (FIFO) to minimize expiry waste. See [Credit expiry & recharging](/credit-expiry-recharging) for expiry rules.

---

## Common issues

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Payment succeeded but credits didn't arrive">
    Webhook delays can take up to 5 minutes. Check **Settings → Billing → Transaction History**. If the status is "Pending," wait. If "Failed," contact support with the transaction ID.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="Card declined — what should I do?">
    Common causes: insufficient funds, 3DS challenge not completed, card not enabled for international transactions, or anti-fraud block. Try a different card or payment method (UPI, bank transfer).
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="Can I use a prepaid or virtual card?">
    Yes, as long as the card supports recurring merchant authorizations. Some VCCs block tokenization—test with a small purchase first.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="My company requires purchase orders (PO). Can I pay by invoice?">
    Yes, for **annual Enterprise plans** (minimum $10,000/year). Email **sales@emergent.ai** with your PO, and we will issue a NET-30 invoice. Pay-as-you-go credit purchases do not support invoicing.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

---
